Definition: Specimen code as printed (G = guanaco, A = alpaca, L = llama, with the animal's number)
Accepted name of the specimen's form (alpaca Vicugna pacos; llama Lama glama; guanaco Lama guanicoe)
Note: Kruska treated all three as one species (see species_as_printed); the accepted names follow current taxonomy
Verbatim: Lama guanacoe (guanaco), Lama guanacoe f. pakos (alpaca), Lama guanacoe f. glama (llama); Kruska held the guanaco to be the sole stem species of llama and alpaca

Definition: Whole-brain volume in mm3, fresh state (Hirnvolumen): fresh brain weight / specific gravity of brain substance 1.035
Note: Derived from the fresh weight at 1.035 g/cm3 (see _COMMON_CALCULATIONS.md); the reference against which the section volumes were shrinkage-corrected. The mean of the two alpaca specimens (180502, 182432) is 181467 mm3 = the 181.467 cm3 Castillo-Morales et al. 2016 print for Vicugna pacos

Definition: Volume of pure brain substance (Reine Hirnsubstanz) in mm3 -- brain volume net of meninges/ventricular spaces as delimited in the sections; the reference volume for the paper's relative-share tables
Note: Shrinkage-corrected to fresh state like all part volumes
From complete serial sections (planimetric paper-weighing after Stephan 1960); per-brain correction factor = fresh brain volume / total section volume

Definition: Medulla oblongata volume in mm3 (fresh, shrinkage-corrected)
Neocortex volume in mm3 (fresh, shrinkage-corrected); grey + white matter
Note: The mean of the two alpaca specimens (99985, 103635) is 101810 mm3 = the 101.81 cm3 Castillo-Morales et al. 2016 print for Vicugna pacos

Definition: Neocortex grey matter volume in mm3 (Neocortex grau)
Note: Grey + white sums to Neocortex_mm3 (within 1 mm3 rounding)
